Bind width/depth/height|thick|plate_t param names to box axes instead of hardcoding observed bbox extents.
When hole_d is present, cut a centered through-hole in the parametric box instead of a solid box.
When hole_x and hole_y are present with hole_d, place the through-hole at (hole_x, hole_y) instead of center so centroid tracks offset params.
When radius is present, emit a parametric cylinder (circle(radius).extrude(height)) instead of a bbox box so circular solids track radius/height on held-out vectors.
When outer_r and inner_r are present, emit a parametric tube (circle(outer_r).circle(inner_r).extrude(height)) instead of a solid bbox box so annular solids track radii/height on held-out vectors.
When cbore_d and cbore_h are present with hole_d, use cboreHole instead of plain hole so the counterbore cavity volume tracks held-out vectors.

When boss_x and boss_y are present with boss_d/boss_h, place the cylindrical boss at (boss_x, boss_y) instead of center so centroid tracks offset params.
When fillet_r is present, fillet the vertical (|Z) edges of the parametric box so corner radius tracks held-out vectors.
When chamfer is present, chamfer the vertical (|Z) edges of the parametric box so corner bevel size tracks held-out vectors.
When slot_l and slot_w are present, cut a centered through-slot (slot2D + cutThruAll) in the parametric plate so slot length/width track held-out vectors.
When pitch is present with hole_d, cut two through-holes via rarray(pitch,1,2,1) so hole spacing tracks the pitch param on held-out vectors.
When fillet_r is present, fillet all box edges (not only |Z) so spherical corner blends match held-out volume/extent.
When chamfer is present, chamfer all box edges (not only |Z) so full-corner bevels match held-out volume/extent, mirroring the successful fillet_r all-edges change.
When chamfer is present, chamfer the top-face edges (faces('>Z').edges()) instead of vertical |Z edges so the top bevel shifts centroid and volume to match held-out vectors.
When slot_x and slot_y are present with slot_l/slot_w, place the through-slot at (slot_x, slot_y) instead of center so centroid tracks offset params.
Bind length/breadth/thickness as axis aliases (X/Y/Z) when width/depth/height|thick|plate_t are absent so alternate dim names still drive the parametric box.
When csink_d and csink_angle are present with hole_d, use cskHole instead of plain hole so the countersink cone volume tracks held-out vectors.
